questions.question_text:
According to classical free electron theory, in the absence of external electrical field, the free electrons __________
(A) Move randomly and collide with each other
(B) Move randomly without collision
(C) Remain stable
(D) Move uniformly
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: In the absence of a field, electrons move in random directions due to thermal energy and undergo frequent collisions with lattice ions.

questions.question_text:
A hole in the semiconductors treated as __________
(A) A free electron
(B) A incomplete part of covalent bond
(C) A free proton
(D) A free neutron
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: A hole is effectively an empty state in the valence band created by the absence of an electron in a covalent bond.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text:
A unit of vibrational energy due to oscillating atoms within a crystal is known as __________
(A) Photons
(B) Phonons
(C) Bhor magneton
(D) Electrons
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Phonons are the discrete units (quanta) of lattice vibrations in a crystal.

questions.question_text:
The probability of finding the electron at E = Ef at 100 K
(A) 0%
(B) 100%
(C) 50%
(D) 25%
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: According to the Fermi-Dirac distribution f(E) = 1 / [exp((E-Ef)/kT) + 1], at E=Ef, f(E) = 1/2 or 50% for any T > 0.

questions.question_text:
The Fermi level of n-type semiconductor __________ while increasing temperature
(A) Increases
(B) Decreases
(C) Remains constant
(D) Depends on the doped element
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: As temperature increases, the semiconductor becomes more intrinsic, causing the Fermi level in an n-type material to move downward toward the middle of the bandgap.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text:
The Fermi level in a p-semiconductor located at __________
(A) The top of the valence band
(B) The top of the conduction band
(C) The bottom of the valence band
(D) The bottom of the conduction band
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: In p-type semiconductors, the Fermi level is situated just above the top of the valence band at low temperatures.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text:
A photon of frequency v interact with electrons and holes of specific energies and momentum is determined by __________
(A) V-I diagram
(B) Band diagram
(C) E-P diagram
(D) E-k diagram
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: The E-k (energy vs. wave vector) diagram illustrates the relationship between energy and crystal momentum for carriers.

questions.question_text:
Fermi’s golden rule which describes the optical __________
(A) Transition level
(B) Transition rate
(C) Band theory
(D) Block body radiation
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Fermi's Golden Rule is a mathematical formula used to calculate the transition rate (probability per unit time) of a quantum system.

questions.question_text:
If the voltage of the potential barrier is V0. A voltage V is applied to the input, at what moments will the barrier disappears?
(A) V < V0
(B) V > V0
(C) V = V0
(D) V << V0
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The built-in potential barrier (V0) is overcome when the applied forward bias (V) exceeds it.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text:
Which process gives the laser its special properties as an optical source?
(A) Dispersion
(B) Stimulated absorption
(C) Spontaneous emission
(D) Stimulated emission
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: Laser (Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) relies on stimulated emission to produce coherent, monochromatic light.

questions.question_text:
Short circuit current (Isc) in solar cell due to
(A) Threshold current flow
(B) Maximum current flow
(C) Potential across the junction
(D) Maximum Voltage
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Short circuit current is the maximum current that a solar cell can deliver when its terminals are connected with zero resistance.

questions.question_text:
If the positive terminal of the battery is connected to the anode of the diode, then it is kwn as __________
(A) Forward biased
(B) Reverse biased
(C) Equilibrium
(D) Schottky barrier
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Connecting the positive terminal to the p-region (anode) and negative to the n-region (cathode) constitutes forward biasing.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text:
How many times should a Monte Carlo simulation model be run?
(A) 100 times
(B) Hundreds or thousands of times
(C) Three times
(D) Once
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Monte Carlo simulations rely on statistical sampling, requiring a large number of trials to achieve accuracy and minimize variance.

questions.question_text:
To identify the nature of semiconductor (p-type or n – type) __________ method will be used.
(A) Two-point method
(B) Linear four-point method
(C) Van der Pauw four-point method
(D) Hall effect
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: The Hall effect determines the sign and density of charge carriers, identifying whether a material is p-type or n-type.

questions.question_text:
In linear four probe method the tip of probe diameter is usually __________ than the probe spacing
(A) Larger
(B) Cooler
(C) Hotter
(D) Smaller
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: To minimize geometric errors in resistivity calculation, probe tips should be small relative to the spacing.

questions.question_text:
The Hall voltage is __________
(A) Perpendicular to electric and magnetic field
(B) Parallel to electric and magnetic field
(C) Perpendicular to electric field
(D) Perpendicular to Hall current
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Hall voltage is generated in a direction perpendicular to both the electric current and the applied magnetic field (Lorentz force direction).

questions.question_text:
Nano particles are special mainly because of their __________
(A) Surface area
(B) Surface charge
(C) Volume
(D) Force
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: High surface area per unit volume at the nanoscale leads to unique properties not found in bulk forms.

questions.question_text:
Which among the following helps us in getting a 3D picture of the specimen?
(A) TEM
(B) SEM
(C) Compound microscope
(D) Simple microscope
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) produces 3D-like images of the surface topography of a sample.

questions.question_text:
In PVD chamber, the precursors are introduced to the reaction chamber in the __________ state
(A) Liquid
(B) Solid
(C) Gaseous
(D) Semi solid
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: In Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), the material to be deposited starts in a solid state and is vaporized physically.

questions.question_text:
The physical parameter that is probed in AFM resulting from different interactions is
(A) Charge
(B) Force
(C) Potential
(D) Field
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: AFM measures atomic forces between the scanning tip and the surface.
